1.consolidated_definition: Una especie de batata, de piel morada y pulpa blanca, de las muchas que abundaban en Puerto Rico, Cuba y Santo Domingo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: A type of sweet potato, with a purple skin and white pulp, one of the many varieties that were abundant in Puerto Rico, Cuba, and Santo Domingo.
